criterion_text: The consolidated adapter does not regress OSC 52/5522 semantics, authorized-controller/observer/replay guards, bounded notices, or native text and negotiated image paste. HTTP never advertises automatic remote clipboard write capability it cannot provide, and no remote request reads local clipboard without user authorization.

verifiers.summary: The shared clipboard owner keeps the Terminal protocol, authorization, replay/observer, notice and paste semantics intact, with one lockfile-pinned library integration

evidence.value: exact SHA 8726a4dd6301d14732b79fe4e9f40a9402fcec40: clipboard protocol/controller tests pass (31 + 5 + 9 + 9 tests); the Terminal adapter delegates every write to the single shared owner, which keeps the EPERM/EIO vocabulary and MIME item, integrates copy-to-clipboard (4.0.2, MIT, lockfile-pinned) for text, attempts the HTTP legacy path for automatic OSC 52, and preserves secure-context detection for the async capability answer
